description: Renovate rules shared by the Carbonio UI repositories. Extend it after the infra-renovate-config presets: "github>zextras/carbonio-ui-configs//rules/renovate"

packageRules.description: Runtime minor/patch updates are bundled weekly by the update-deps skill: keep them listed in the Dependency Dashboard and open a PR only on demand
One weekly auto-merged devDependencies bundle instead of one PR (and one patch release) per package

Widen peer ranges instead of bumping them: the shared javascript preset forces rangeStrategy 'bump' globally, which narrows the range consumers are built against without gaining anything. Widening stays silent for in-range releases and opens a PR only when a new major has to be allowed
pnpm overrides are deliberate pins: keep minor/patch on the Dependency Dashboard like the runtime dependencies above, so only majors open a PR
engines.node selects the CI container (uiPipeline reads its first number) and, in published libraries, ships to npm: keep it a major range instead of bumping it to the current patch
Node majors are migrated by hand, one repository at a time: list them in the Dependency Dashboard and open a PR only on demand
